title: VeriSM
lead: Value-driven, Evolving, Responsive, Integrated Service Management — a modern ITSM framework that adapts to organisational context.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: VeriSM is a service management framework that emphasises flexibility and value. Rather than prescribing specific processes, it provides a Management Mesh — a set of resources, environment, service management practices and emerging technologies that organisations combine to deliver services. VeriSM is designed to work alongside DevOps, Agile and other practices.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: VeriSM's non-prescriptive approach makes it suitable for ITOM engagements where a bespoke service management model is required. Its Management Mesh concept aligns well with ITOM's multi-dimensional view of the operating model.

items.desc: The combination of resources, environment, practices and technologies used to deliver services.
Focus on outcomes that matter to consumers, not on internal process compliance.
Continuous adaptation of service management to changing business needs.
Rapid response to change using agile and DevOps practices.
Combining multiple management practices rather than following a single framework.
